user.title: Connect to Hearth
user.description: Paste the pairing token from your Hearth dashboard. The integration will open an outbound connection to Hearth; no ports need to be forwarded.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Hearth. Check the URL and your internet connection.

abort.already_configured: This Hearth installation is already configured.

connection.title: Connection to Hearth
connection.description: Installation {installation_id} at {hub_url} is currently {status}. Turning the connection off closes the outbound link immediately; nothing can reach this Home Assistant until you turn it back on. The connection switch entity does the same.

capabilities.title: What the AI may access
capabilities.description: Each switch grants the AI (your own AI client through the Hearth connector, and the Managed assistant) one area. Reads never change anything; writes create, edit, and delete items the same way the Home Assistant editor does. On top of these, only entities exposed to Assist (Settings → Voice assistants → Expose) are ever visible. Locks, cameras, alarms, and locations are never accessible, even inside automations.

data.cap_services_read: Read the service catalog (for authoring actions)
